newsitem.title: USA: Specialty Foods considers sale of Stella Foods.
newsitem.headline: Specialty Foods considers sale of Stella Foods.

text.p: Specialty Foods Corp said Tuesday it retained Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp to advise it in connection with the potential sale of its Stella Foods Inc subsidiary.

Specialty Foods said the contemplated sale of Stella Foods, the fifth largest cheese producer in the United States, is part of a shift in focus to its baking operations. Those baking operations include Metz Baking Co, Mother's Cake & Cookie Co and Andre-Boudin Bakeries.
Proceeds from the potential sale would be used to retire debt and to invest in the baking industry.
Metz, Specialty's largest baking unit, is a leading baker and distributor of bread products throughout the central U.S.

Mother's is the second largest manufacturer and distributor of branded cookie products sold through retail grocers in the western United States. Andre-Boudin Bakeries operates a chain of 40 bakery cafes in the San Francisco Bay area, Southern California, Chicago and Dallas.

Stella Foods has major positions in Italian and other specialty cheese categories. Its product line is sold to retail as well as commercial and institutional customers under a variety of brand names including Stella, Frigo, Lorraine, Dragone and Gardenia

"Since the company was acquired in 1993, it has been a major area of focus for Specialty Foods," Lawrence Benjamin, president, said in a statement. "Stella has benefited from very substantial capital investments and marketing initiatives that have transformed the company's regional operations into an integrated business with national scope."
In addition to Metz, Mother's and Andre-Boudin, Specialty Foods will retain H & M Foods, a leading producer of custom-formulated specialty meat products, as a separate subsidiary.
